title: Utility Services Program Billing Calendar: Proration, Final Bill Timing and Billed Occupants
content:
# Billing Calendar Settings — Utility Services Program

| Program | Proration for partial months | Calendar days after the service end date within which the final utility bill is issued | When a change in billed occupants takes effect | Who counts as a billed occupant |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Essentials Utility Plan | actual days in the month | 30 | the next billing period | every approved occupant on the lease |
| Water-Sewer-Trash Allocation Plan | actual days in the month | 45 | the next billing period | every approved occupant on the lease |
| Submetered Water Plan | actual days in the month | 45 | the next billing period | every approved occupant on the lease |
| Submetered Water & Gas Plan | actual days in the month | 45 | the next billing period | every approved occupant on the lease |
| Submetered Water, Gas & Electric Plan | actual days in the month | 45 | the next billing period | every approved occupant on the lease |
| All-Inclusive Utility Package | actual days in the month | 30 | the next billing period | every approved occupant on the lease |

## Settings in words

- Proration on every program is by the actual days in the month.
- The final utility bill is issued within 30 calendar days of the service end date on the Essentials Utility Plan and the All-Inclusive Utility Package, and within 45 calendar days on the other four programs.
- A change in billed occupants takes effect from the next billing period, and billed occupants are the persons on the lease — every approved occupant on it.

*Illustration (hypothetical dates):* a Submetered Water Plan account whose service ends on June 30 has its final utility bill issued no later than the 45th calendar day after June 30.
